row: Freyja's Friends Small Farm Animal Rescue

We are a nonprofit (501c3) rescue and sanctuary for small farm animals. Located in Southern California.

We help animals and people, as well. The unwanted and the broken need someone to love them. Repurposing gives purpose to something that was seemingly “useless.” I wanted to feel that I still had purpose, so I give that feeling to others whenever I can. 

Become one of Freyja’s Friends at freyjasfriends.org and inquire how donate time, money, supplies, or advice. Find us on Facebook and Instagram. https://www.facebook.com/jennifer.rescuer?mibextid=wwXIfr is monetized, so like, comment, and share to help for free!

It’s okay to not be okay sometimes. You and other animals don’t have to be thrown away, you still have purpose.
